title: Naruto: Shippuden
desc: Naruto begins his sage jutsu training at Mount Myoboku under Fukasaku. But his first challenge is not to move as Fukasaku explains that a lot of time is needed in order to harness nature energy.

desc: Naruto goes back to Mount Myoboku to continue his Sage training, but it progresses very slowly. This annoys Fukasaku, and he suggests that they move on to the next training exercise.
